acceptance_checks: .shiki/schemas/cca-evidence-manifest.schema.json defines the workflow-generated CCA evidence manifest contract.
scripts/shiki_evidence.py and scripts/build_cca_evidence_manifest.py generate and validate manifest file digests, workflow metadata, PR/head metadata, artifact metadata, and verdict metadata.
scripts/mergegate_check.py validates the downloaded CCA evidence manifest against live PR state, current task/Goal ids, and required evidence file digests.
Ledger entries accept legacy entries without evidence_refs and validate evidence_refs / ledger_integrity when present.
scripts/validate_shiki.py and scripts/shiki_doctor.py validate/report CCA evidence integrity wiring.
scripts/test_shiki_evidence_integrity.sh covers manifest generation, validation failures, MergeGate integration, ledger evidence_refs, digest checks, and workflow static wiring.
Docs explain workflow-generated CCA evidence, .shiki/gha distrust, manifest digest checks, ledger evidence_refs, and the non-signing boundary.
Verification bundle passes: validate_shiki, py_compile, scripts/test_shiki_*.sh, git diff --check, and shiki_evidence import smoke.
non_goals: Do not implement P1.4.5 mirror/generated/cache/local-only state classification.
Do not implement P1.4.6 full forged/stale/missing governance evidence tests.
Do not add external signing, KMS, GPG, Sigstore, or a GitHub App.
Do not change Guardian policy semantics.
Do not change CCA Review Bridge semantics.
Do not change branch protection or CODEOWNERS.
Do not change runtime adapter behavior.
Do not redesign the migration framework.
Do not add Node workflow compatibility work.
Do not add P2 distribution, onboarding, packaging, or release work.
scope: Harden CCA verdict artifact integrity and ledger evidence cross-references for Goal #30 P1.4.3-P1.4.4 by adding workflow-generated CCA evidence manifests, digest validation, MergeGate enforcement, ledger evidence_refs, validator/doctor/docs/tests integration, and implementation ledger evidence.
title: Harden CCA verdict evidence and ledger cross-references
